items.description: Replacement of stolen clothing, personal effects and everyday jewellery
items.rationale: Sections 2.6.3 and 4.2.6 require scheduled contents cover, which is not confirmed. If that cover is in force and the loss is substantiated, §§4.4.5–4.4.6 and 7.1.1(d) support an estimated €750 for like-for-like replacement of the ordinary items, without the €1,000 high-value per-article cap.

items.description: Emergency repair and re-securing of forced door
items.rationale: If the forcible-removal peril is in force, §§2.6.2 and 5.2.2 cover necessary like-for-like work to make the forced door secure, subject to proof of the cost incurred. Estimated gross labour and materials of €350 are below the €1,000 emergency-securing cap; no deductible amount is shown.
